source: User screenshots and explicit follow-up confirmations

model.skillBaselines: Captured totals, editable and held fixed when lineup changes; do not reapply raw Skill Power, milestone, synergy, GM or event boosts.
model.stacking: Independent Kill Gold and Super Gold amount factors; Sovereign chance joins existing shared Gold overflow pool once.
model.tileInventory: Up to three milestone, three synergy and three skill tiles, and one Kill Gold tile for a single killer; one tile per hero. Inventory count of Kill Gold tiles is a calculator assumption.
model.timing: Conditional payout while all listed skills are active and in range; not uptime-averaged or gold per second.
